entries.title: Psalms 76:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A Song.>> In Judah God [is] known; His name [is] great in Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 76:2
segments: In Salem also is His tabernacle, And His dwelling place in Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 76:3
segments: There He broke the arrows of the bow, The shield and sword of battle. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 76:4
segments: You [are] more glorious and excellent [Than] the mountains of prey.

entries.title: Psalms 76:5
segments: The stouthearted were plundered; They have sunk into their sleep; And none of the mighty men have found the use of their hands.

entries.title: Psalms 76:6
segments: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both the chariot and horse were cast into a dead sleep.

entries.title: Psalms 76:7
segments: ¶You, Yourself, [are] to be feared; And who may stand in Your presence When once You are angry?

entries.title: Psalms 76:8
segments: You caused judgment to be heard from heaven; The earth feared and was still,

entries.title: Psalms 76:9
segments: When God arose to judgment, To deliver all the oppressed of the earth. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 76:10
segments: Surely the wrath of man shall praise You; With the remainder of wrath You shall gird Yourself.

entries.title: Psalms 76:11
segments: Make vows to the LORD your God, and pay [them]; Let all who are around Him bring presents to Him who ought to be feared.

entries.title: Psalms 76:12
segments: He shall cut off the spirit of princes; [He is] awesome to the kings of the earth.
